description: This file defines a React component named DeploymentStatusBarChart that renders a themed, accessible bar chart visualizing deployment statuses and counts. It includes internal methods for rendering tooltips, labels, and handling user interactions, and imports various external components and utilities for styling, data formatting, and state management.

methods.name: CustomTooltip
methods.description: A React component that renders a styled tooltip showing deployment status and count when hovering over a bar.

methods.name: ValueLabel
methods.description: A React component that renders the label above each bar indicating its count.

methods.name: auditLogInteraction
methods.description: A function that logs user interactions such as bar clicks and legend clicks for auditing purposes.
